title: The name check misses Windows' 8.3 short form of a long profile name, which temp paths carry
goal: backlog.py's name pieces include the 8.3 short form of a name longer than 8 characters (its first six letters or digits and a tilde, as in a TEMP path's profile folder), and the profile folder's name (USERPROFILE, HOME) counts as the user's name. Found by the SP-2agxqrrv review.
